painTitle: Referrals built the firm. They won't grow it.

pain.heading: New work depends on who you already know
pain.body: Clients arrive when a past client or a contact happens to mention you. Business development fits between client work, so the pipeline rises and falls with how busy the partners are.

pain.heading: Expertise nobody outside your network can see
pain.body: Years of good work sit in client files and partners' heads. A founder searching for help finds a services page that reads like every other firm's.

pain.heading: Selling feels at odds with advising
pain.body: Partners don't want to sound like vendors, and generic cold pitches would hurt a reputation built on judgment and trust. So outreach doesn't happen at all.

flowTitle:
From partner expertise to booked consultation
In your voice, approved by you

flowTop.title: ICP & Trigger Mapping
flowTop.body: Define the clients you serve best by size, sector and situation, and the moments they look for help: growth, restructuring, a new market or a compliance change.

flowTop.title: Verified Decision-Maker Lists
flowTop.body: Founders, CXOs, CHROs, CFOs and business heads at those companies, checked by hand before anyone is contacted.

flowTop.title: Voice Capture
flowTop.body: One onboarding call captures how your partners explain their work, so every post and message sounds like them.

flowParallel.title: Profile Positioning
flowParallel.body: Headline, banner and about section built around the outcome you deliver, not a list of services.

flowParallel.title: Insight-Led Content
flowParallel.body: Posts on the decisions your clients face, such as scaling, restructuring, tax planning or leadership, that show how you think.

flowParallel.title: Confidentiality First
flowParallel.body: No client names or engagement details in content or outreach without written permission.

flowBottom.title: Launch Approved Outreach
flowBottom.body: LinkedIn and email outreach go live only after a partner approves the messages, at a pace that stays personal.

flowBottom.title: Qualify on Real Need
flowBottom.body: Follow-ups establish the prospect's situation and timing before a call is booked, so consultations are with buyers who have a live problem.

flowBottom.title: Book Consultations
flowBottom.body: Qualified founders and business heads land in your calendar with context, so the first call starts with their situation.

process.title: Onboarding & Voice Capture
process.body: A 1 to 2 hour onboarding call covers the clients you want more of, the engagements you lead with and how your partners talk about their work.

process.title: Profile & Content
process.body: We reposition the lead partner's LinkedIn profile and, on managed plans, write 4 to 8 posts a month in their voice.

process.title: Partner-Approved Outreach
process.body: Targeted messages to founders and business heads open on a specific situation, never a service menu, and a partner approves them before anything is sent.

process.title: Qualified Consultation Handoff
process.body: Interested prospects land in your calendar with context. Proposals, pricing and the advice itself always stay with your firm.

caseCards.headline: A referral-dependent founder becomes an inbound engine
caseCards.body: A professional services founder relied almost entirely on referrals. We rebuilt the LinkedIn profile and ran a consistent content programme aimed at the exact buyers the firm wanted.

caseCards.headline: Building visibility outside the referral network
caseCards.body: A consulting firm with experienced partners was invisible beyond its existing clients. We positioned its leaders around practical transformation insights and paired that content with targeted outreach to founders and business heads.

caseCards.headline: Reaching companies in the middle of growth or restructuring
caseCards.body: An HR consulting company relied on its own network. We targeted founders, CHROs and HR heads at growth-stage companies, with content on talent planning, organisational design and leadership development.

whyTitle: Built for firms that sell expertise
whyIntro: Some professions limit how members can win clients. Bar Council of India rules restrict advocates from soliciting work, and ICAI's Code of Ethics restricts chartered accountants in practice, so we don't run cold outreach for Indian law or CA practices' own services. Every firm should confirm its own professional body's rules.

whyCards.title: Management, strategy & retail consultancies
whyCards.body: Firms selling transformation, operations, store design or growth work to founders and business heads. One retail consultancy reached 69 hot leads across 8+ industries.

whyCards.title: HR, leadership & coaching practices
whyCards.body: HR consultants, leadership development brands and business coaches. One coaching practice won 4 corporate workshop opportunities and 9 paid consultation discussions.

whyCards.title: Tax & advisory firms that can market directly
whyCards.body: Tax, compliance and business advisory firms reaching founders and CFOs. One tax advisory firm reached 23 qualified leads. Finance-outsourcing firms have their own page for accounting and CFO firms.
